acceptance_criteria.criterion: `data-flows.md` contains a `## 9. Error Handling` section as the final numbered section

The section includes a flow diagram covering the canonical error-check path: `str_get_html()`/`file_get_html()` failure → `Settings::set('__error', ...)` → returns `false` → consumer calls `simple_html_dom_get_error()` → checks error code (1001/1002/1003)

summary: Added `## 9. Error Handling` as the final section of `docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md`. The new section documents the canonical error-check path: `str_get_html()`/`file_get_html()` failure → `Settings::set('__error', new Error(...))` → returns `false` → consumer calls `simple_html_dom_get_error()` → inspects `$error->getCode()` (1001 empty / 1002 oversized / 1003 bad HTTP) and `$error->getMessage()`. Sections 1–8 were not modified.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. The new section follows the existing ASCII-flow style of all prior sections, uses the same indented arrow convention, and correctly cross-references both bridge functions (str_get_html / file_get_html) as well as the Error value object API.
